segments.name: Walmart U.S.
segments.description: Mass merchandiser of consumer products serving U.S. customers through retail stores, walmart.com and the Walmart mobile application.
segments.evidence: Walmart U.S. is a mass merchandiser of consumer products, operating under the "Walmart" and "Walmart Neighborhood Market" brands, as well as walmart.com and the Walmart mobile application.

segments.name: Walmart International
segments.evidence: Walmart International is our second largest segment and operates 5,743 stores across 18 countries outside of the U.S.

segments.name: Sam's Club U.S.
segments.description: Membership-only warehouse club serving U.S. members through clubs and eCommerce.
segments.evidence: Sam's Club U.S. is a membership-only warehouse club that operates 601 clubs in 44 states in the U.S. and Puerto Rico and also operates samsclub.com and the Sam's Club mobile application.

revenueModel.text: Customers and members pay for merchandise purchased in stores and online, plus membership fees, advertising, marketplace, fulfillment and financial services.
revenueModel.evidence: As we execute on our strategy globally, our business continues to expand through offerings such as membership, advertising, marketplace and fulfillment services, and financial services.
